subject: Deployment transition & validation sprint — EdgeBridge private stack
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@edgebridge.io>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@edgebridge.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment transition & validation sprint — EdgeBridge private stack

Hi Samira / Carlos,

Thanks again for the call this morning. To keep momentum and avoid last-minute surprises during the private deployment, I put together a short sprint plan and a connectivity checklist (attached). The goal is to hand over the deployment from Success -> Implementation -> Ops with clearly defined validation gates.

High-level proposal (3-week sprint):
- Week 1: Network preflight and VPC peering tests (CIDR validation, ACLs, DNS, routes).
- Week 2: Private endpoints and service wiring; install on-prem package in staging; HSM/KMS handshake.
- Week 3: Acceptance and production cutover weekend (smoke tests + traffic validation).

Immediate asks for EdgeBridge:
1) Confirm the maintenance window that works for you (we typically prefer a 4-6 hour window overnight).
2) Share the public IP blocks and any firewall ACLs we should expect.
3) Point your networking lead to the checklist and confirm who's owning each item.

Attachments: edgebridge_connectivity_checklist_v1.xlsx, onprem_package_manifest.tar.gz (stub)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cEdgeBridgeOnboard

I'll schedule a 30-minute preflight sync for Tuesday to walk through the checklist if that works. Camila and Grace will be on the implementation side; Laura will be doing the HSM/key work.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Carlos Vega <c.vega@edgebridge.io>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Apr 2026 12:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment transition & validation sprint — EdgeBridge private stack

Hi Ben,

Thanks — this looks good. Quick clarifying questions from our end before the preflight sync:
- Can you confirm the VPC peering CIDR pairs you've seen work with Redwood previously? We have several /16s in our prod account and want to avoid overlap.
- For egress, do you expect NAT IPs from our side or will Redwood route outbound traffic via the peered connection?
- The HSM/KMS step: is it mandatory for staging or can we do key provisioning in prod-only?

Proposed window: May 9-10 (weekend) for the cutover but we'll confirm after the preflight.

I'll bring our network engineer (cc'd Samira) to the Tuesday sync.

—Carlos
Carlos Vega
Engineering Lead, EdgeBridge
c.vega@edgebridge.io

---
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <c.vega@edgebridge.io>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@edgebridge.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment transition & validation sprint — EdgeBridge private stack

Carlos — thanks for the questions. Short answers inline below and we can walk through the details on Tuesday's call.

- VPC peering CIDRs: we've successfully peered with ranges in the 10.20.0.0/16, 10.30.0.0/16 families. For EdgeBridge, recommend reserving a /16 that doesn't overlap with 10.0.0.0/8 used internally; we'll validate in the checklist.
- Egress behavior: Redwood's private endpoints rely on routes over the peering. We do not NAT outbound tokens through your NAT by default — any outbound egress to external services should be routed via your egress (we will document required IP allowlists if you need to reach Redwood control-plane endpoints).
- HSM/KMS: staging can use a temporary key for validation, but for final acceptance we require the production keypair or HSM integration to be exercised so we can validate key rotation and audit logs. Laura will own the HSM acceptance steps.

Proposed production cutover slot: May 9, 2026 23:00 UTC -> May 10, 2026 03:00 UTC (4 hours). If that works for your team we'll lock it and create the runbook for the weekend.

Tentative preflight sync: Tue Apr 28 2026 14:00 UTC / 07:00 PT. I'll send a calendar invite.

Ben

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment transition & validation sprint — EdgeBridge private stack

Thanks team — quick ops notes from my side before the preflight: 

- I've sketched an acceptance checklist that maps to the connectivity doc (attached as certificate_handoff_runbook.md). Key items: TLS certificate handoff, CA trust chain verification, CN/SANs for private endpoints, and mutual TLS test cases.
- Laura: please confirm availability for key provisioning and HSM test on May 4-6. We need a dry-run in staging at least 72 hours before the cutover.
- Camila: can you capture the exact subnets + expected route table entries in the checklist and share preflight test commands we will run from our side (curl + mTLS tests, DNS lookups, traceroutes)?

I'll also coordinate a short ops-only call the day before the cutover to validate rollback steps and post-cutover verification.

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

Attachment: certificate_handoff_runbook.md

- Maintenance window May 9 23:00 UTC -> May 10 03:00 UTC works.
- We'll provide our public IP blocks and the NAT ranges by EOD Wednesday (Apr 29).
- Staging HSM: we'll enable a temporary key for the staging dry-run and coordinate with Laura for the prod key provisioning.
- DocuSign: please send over the final SOW addendum for the private deployment and the contact for monthly maintenance window approvals.

I'll be on the preflight call Tuesday and will bring our network engineer. Thanks for the clear checklist — makes this much easier.

Best,
